title: Rookie CB Ceyair Wright reportedly leaves Bengals to pursue acting opportunity he 'couldn't pass up'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rookie CB Ceyair Wright reportedly leaves Bengals to pursue acting opportunity he 'couldn't pass up'
sources.description: Wright, who signed with Cincinnati as an undrafted free agent out of Nebraska, starred as LeBron James' son in "Space Jam: A New Legacy."
